title: Natural transformation
description: JSON Schema for a natural transformation eta: F => G between two parallel functors F, G: C -> D (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. I §4; Awodey 2010 §7). The data is a family of component morphisms in D, one per object of C; the naturality axiom — for every f: A -> B in C, G(f) compose eta_A = eta_B compose F(f) — is a universally-quantified equation checked by naturality transformers, not by JSON Schema.

source-functor.description: The name of the source functor F.

target-functor.description: The name of the target functor G. F and G must be parallel — same source category, same target category — which is checked outside the schema.

components.description: Map indexed by source-category object names. components[A] is the name of the component morphism eta_A in the target category D, with domain F(A) and codomain G(A). Every key satisfies name-shape via propertyNames; every value satisfies name-shape via additionalProperties.
